docs: Locations content: the heading, a description, one picture (a map or a place) and an ordered list of offices, each with a name and the address. One object is valid in every locations layout (the picture at the start, at the end).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

image.docs: address of the picture; none: the placeholder

items.docs: the offices, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

title.docs: the name of the office or the city

description.docs: the address and the hours; empty: none
